comparison.objective: Route conduit between boxes only through permitted horizontal/vertical wall zones; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Selecting and placing conduit lengths into an L-shaped route versus fine tool insertion, adjustment, locking, and impact-response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Joined safe-zone route with no diagonal or spare out-of-zone segment versus two safe carriage stops and no setting drift. No separate spec versions were provided.
comparison.reason: This tests rule-aware routing and placement, not mechanical tuning.
